name: Midjourney
summary: Midjourney generates images from a text prompt. A business user can make a concept image or an illustration for a deck.
paragraphs: Midjourney generates images from a text prompt. A business user can make a concept image or an illustration for a deck.
whyItMatters: Use it for a concept image, and do not treat the picture as a photo of a real aircraft, part, or place.
